Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually
bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

Work to be carried out
Disconnect the terminals of the relay and
get it out of the panel .
Clean the relay using a spray .
Clean the contacts of the relay using
contact burnisher .
Connect the relay terminals (1) with
positive and terminal (2) with negative and terminal (10) with lockout relay .
Connect the relay terminals (19,3) to the testing instrument output .
Repeat No (5) with terminals ( 11 , 3) ,
(15 , 5) , (13 , 4) , (9 , 5) and ( 7 , 5) .
Adjust the testing instrument output to
equal the operating current of relay and record the tripping time
(instantaneous) .
connect the
relay terminals again and connect DC power supply .
